lines.text: Formerly the Gentiles were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and without hope.
Through Christ's blood, those far away have been brought near, and He has torn down the wall of hostility.
Christ abolished the law of commandments to create a nation of Gentiles, reconciling both groups to God through the cross.
Christ preached peace to those far away and those near, so the Gentiles became fellow citizens with the saints.
The household is built on the apostles and prophets, with Peter as the cornerstone, and grows into a holy temple.
